bio.text: Patty McMahon is the Libertarian Party nominee for Colorado's 6th Congressional District in 2026.

According to her campaign website, she spent 35 years in federal service with the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission and served as the Region VIII lead for the White House Initiative on Asian Americans, Native Hawaiians, and Pacific Islanders.
The site says she is a graduate of Metropolitan State University of Denver, has lived in the 6th District for 26 years, and serves on several Colorado nonprofit and civic boards.
